name: What is the process for designing and building a custom shade structure?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for designing and building a custom shade structure?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, needs, and budget. Next, we conduct an on-site evaluation to assess the space and take measurements. Based on this, we develop custom designs and provide detailed proposals, including material options and pricing. Once you approve the design and estimate, we handle the necessary permits. Construction then proceeds, followed by final inspections to ensure everything meets quality and safety standards. Communication is maintained throughout each stage.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, on-site evaluation, custom design and proposal, permit acquisition, construction, and final inspection.
